prior_year_events.event_name: Ogden discount rate considerations / PPO propensity
prior_year_events.impact_description: Ogden discount rate and PPO propensity considered in reserving; influences valuation of long-term personal injury claims and discounting assumptions.

prior_year_events.event_name: TPRe commutation and reinstatement (experience account established)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Commutation and reinstatement of TPRe created a fully collateralised experience account and affected reinsurance recoverables and reserve funding; interest on the experience account has supported results.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior-year claims reserves were essentially unchanged on a gross basis at the 2020 year-end (no material gross prior-year movements per the gross claims development table). The syndicate nevertheless reports net releases of prior-year reserves (Total GBP 18,163k) which reflect favourable claims development and pandemic-related lower claim frequencies, together with reinsurance impacts (including TPRe). Key reserving considerations included PPO propensity/Ogden rate effects and claims cost inflation pressures (used-car price inflation).
raw_causal_phrases: A major improvement in net loss ratio (by 10.1%) was reported from prior year reflecting the improvements made in risk selection and product mix, but predominantly from the benefits on claims frequencies due to the restrictions imposed to limit the spread of COVID-19 which reduced road and vehicle usage.
This offset higher claims costs where the increase in used car prices as new car sales have fallen is driving inflation in the cost of replacing written-off vehicles.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross numbers). The separate 'Movement in prior accident year's provision for claims outstanding' note in the accounts reports only net releases (Total GBP 18,163k) and does not present the gross prior-year movement; therefore gross PYD is taken as zero from the triangle. RITC and TPRe arrangements are present in the accounts and can distort comparisons; where only net figures were shown, net values are reported in exact_reserve_text and flagged.
